item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I thought these tales were supposed to keep it either-or for whether he's a sea slug! :(
And he's not supposed to know that he's a sea slug, regardless.
He did all that human-sized stuff and was treated as human by others in the previous tales (which was part of what made them so amazing), but now he requires huge effort to move cameras and Deeds puts Blackwood on his shoulder.
Also it felt like the British-isms he used weren't as cool as before, like they were used for no reason except because Blackwood uses British-isms.
Maybe Blackwood sounds a lot better after he and Deeds discuss word choice, and this isn't a journal, so that's why. But I'd like to think he's as amazing as his stories make him out to be.

I don't think it was as good as your other ones. I guess it was meant as a short answer to a question and not meant to be Blackwood canon so it wasn't worth all the extreme effort you put into the amazing Blackwood stories for those reasons. And while it wasn't as good as usual, it's probably at or above my usual upvote standards.
I don't know; I guess everyone else seems to like this one. But I still don't (as much as I hoped to) so the total of the upvotes can be high but I'm going to downvote. :(

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Smapti.

You are apparently made of pure awesome.

Blackwood is singlehandedly my favorite character on the site, which is a pretty big achievement for a creature lacking even a single hand.

Have a well-deserved upvote, encouragement, an ego boost and another recommendation to do one of his Lordship's journals starring his adventures at sea to capture a whale-like monster preying upon shipping.

Blackwood vs. pirates!

Also, is it wrong that I'm now imagining the foundation staff panicking and dying in the Class-XK Event while his Lordship oozes about, telepathically yelling at 682 and giggling as whatever happens when 447 comes into contact with dead bodies happens to it? Any how astonishingly silly this would be to watch?
